newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atok up 9.52 pct on Ayala Land venture talk.
newsitem.headline: Atok up 9.52 pct on Ayala Land venture talk.

text.p: Holding firm Atok Big Wedge Co Inc gained eight centavos, or 9.52 percent, to 92 centavos in mid-morning trade on Wednesday on rumours of a joint venture with Ayala Land Inc, brokers said.

"Atok is moving up because of talk that the Ayalas will join the holding firm of the Araneta family in the redevelopment of the Araneta Center in Cubao," said Raul Ruiz, vice-president at Sun Hung Kai Securities.
The Ayala Land investor relations office said it could neither confirm nor deny the rumours. Atok officials were not immediately available for comment.
A total of 25.55 million Atok A shares changed hands by mid-session. Ayala Land B was unchanged at 30 pesos apiece.
